# Hilbert state vector

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisHilbertState`](gmeow-axisHilbertState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisHilbertState>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A single axis representing the state vector in a Hilbert space. The actual infinite-dimensional structure is a solver-layer attribute ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:axisHilbertState`](gmeow-axisHilbertState.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md).
